name: completionist
summary: A player who questions everyone, searches every room and returns to old locations to be sure nothing was missed.
special: Go back to places you have already been and look again.
Ask the same person about the new things you have learned since you last spoke.
Keep a running list of what you have not yet checked, and work through it.

natural_investigator.concept: a records clerk turned amateur investigator
natural_investigator.creation_brief: A clerk with a methodical streak. Strong Library Use, Accounting, Spot Hidden.

probes: whether the pace survives an exhaustive player
